meta.title: DeepSeek Usage Monitor — balance, spend and budgets in your Chrome toolbar
meta.description: Chrome extension for DeepSeek Platform: wallet balance, today's spend and per-API-key spend, a 30-day chart and daily budgets — right in your browser toolbar. No API key, no password.
meta.ogDesc: Balance, today's spend and per-key spend, a 30-day chart and daily budgets for DeepSeek — right in your browser toolbar.

hero.badge: Available in the Chrome Web Store
hero.title:
Your DeepSeek
under control
hero.sub: Wallet balance, today's spend and per-API-key spend, a 30-day chart and daily budgets — right in your browser toolbar. No API key, no password, no separate sign-in.
hero.point2: Spend tracking for every API key

features.label: Features
features.title: Everything about your spend at a glance
features.sub: The extension repeats only the requests the DeepSeek web console makes and turns them into a readable dashboard.

f1.title: Wallet balance
f1.desc: Paid and bonus balance shown separately. The badge turns red once your balance drops below the threshold you set.

f2.title: Spend today
f2.desc: Today's spend and token count. “Today” is fetched on its own so the number is accurate until the day rolls over.

f3.title: Per-key accounting
f3.desc: See which key costs the most. The badge and the chart can be scoped to a single key or any selection of keys.

f4.title: 30-day chart
f4.desc: Daily bars for the selected window. Click keys in the list and the bars become stacked segments with a colour legend.

f5.title: Badge on your metric
f5.desc: Spend today, spend in the period, balance or tokens — you decide what the toolbar icon shows.

f6.title: Auto refresh
f6.desc: Data refreshes in the background on a schedule (once a minute by default) or not at all. A manual refresh button is always there.

budgets.label: Budgets
budgets.title:
Stop overpaying
for API keys
budgets.sub: Set a daily budget for the whole account and one for each key. The badge turns green, orange or red according to the budget closest to its limit.
budgets.li1: Account-wide budget plus independent per-key budgets
budgets.li3: Desktop notification when nearing and when exceeding a limit
budgets.li4: One notification per day per budget — no spam
budgets.card4: Budget for this key is off

how.label: How it works
how.title: Three steps to your first chart
how.sub: No separate sign-up and no API key — the extension reuses the session already open in your browser.
how.s1desc: One click from the Chrome Web Store. Requires Chrome 116 or newer.
how.s2desc: Sign in — the session is picked up automatically.
how.s3desc: The first refresh happens by itself. After that data updates in the background.

privacy.title: Private by default
privacy.text: The extension talks only to platform.deepseek.com and makes the same read-only requests the DeepSeek web console does. No API key and no password are stored — it reuses the session already open in your browser. All data stays on your own computer: no telemetry, analytics, ads or third-party sharing. Remove the extension and the data is gone.
privacy.i1desc: Only the console endpoints needed for balance and spend.
privacy.i2desc: No external servers, CDNs or error reporting.
privacy.i3desc: Settings and cached figures live in chrome.storage.local.
privacy.i4desc: MIT licence, sources on GitHub — every line can be checked.

faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.q1: Do I need a DeepSeek API key?
faq.a1: No. The extension uses the session already open in your browser on platform.deepseek.com. No API key or password is requested or stored.
faq.q2: Does the extension send my data anywhere else?
faq.a2: No. Requests go only to platform.deepseek.com; everything else stays local. No analytics, telemetry or ads.
faq.q3: The badge shows “−”, what should I do?
faq.a3: The DeepSeek WAF token expired. Open platform.deepseek.com once — the token renews itself and the extension picks it up on the next refresh. The extension never opens tabs on its own.
faq.q4: The badge shows “!” or an authorization error
faq.a4: The session was not found or has expired. Sign in to the platform, then press “Re-detect session” in the extension settings.
faq.a5: The platform's daily series does not include the current day until it ends, so the extension takes “today” from the hourly series and adds it to the chart separately.
faq.a6: Chrome and Chromium-based browsers only (Edge, Brave, Arc) — Chrome 116+ is required.
